{"consolidated_memory":"## Malformed Record Issues in ingest/pipeline/parser.py (Three Separate Occasions)

All issues manifested as decode errors pointing at one byte offset in the same corner of the ingest pipeline parser code, but had distinct root causes and were triggered by different conditions.

### Occasion 1 [2026-03-02]
- **Trigger**: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- **Root Cause**: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- **Fix**: Invalidated cache entry inside the write transaction
- **PR**: #5586 on branch fix/malformed-record-1
- **Reproduction**: Feed mixed-encoding sample file
- **Outcome**: Error rate dropped from 2.0% to under 1 per 10,000 (< 0.01%)

### Occasion 2 [2026-04-28]
- **Trigger**: Input list came in empty
- **Root Cause**: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix**: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR**: #6980 on branch fix/malformed-record-2
- **Reproduction**: Feed mixed-encoding sample file
- **Outcome**: Flaky test went from 21 failures per 100 runs to zero failures

### Occasion 3 [2026-08-12]
- **Trigger**: Sessions arrived through OAuth provider
- **Root Cause**: Naive datetime compared against aware datetime
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #9997 on branch fix/malformed-record-3
- **Reproduction**: Feed mixed-encoding sample file
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 2.3s to 883ms

All three occasions involved work in ingest/pipeline/parser.py on the ingest side and used the mixed-encoding sample file for reproduction."}
